schema:
CREATE TABLE ci.runs
(
    `id` UUID CODEC(NONE),
    `tests_id` UInt64 CODEC(ZSTD(1)),
    `environments_id` UInt64 CODEC(ZSTD(1)),
    `env_vars_id` UInt64 CODEC(ZSTD(1)),
    `github_workflow_job_id` Int64 CODEC(Delta(8), ZSTD(1)),
    `report_uuid` UUID CODEC(ZSTD(1)),
    `rerun_number` UInt16,
    `outcome` Enum8('unknown' = 0, 'passed' = 1, 'failed' = 2, 'error' = 3, 'skipped' = 4, 'xfailed' = 5, 'xpassed' = 6, 'crashed' = 7, 'timed_out' = 8) DEFAULT 'unknown',
    `outcome_summary` String CODEC(ZSTD(1)),
    `started_at` DateTime64(3, 'UTC') CODEC(Delta(8), ZSTD(1)),
    `ended_at` DateTime64(3, 'UTC') CODEC(Delta(8), ZSTD(1)),
    PROJECTION by_job
    (
        SELECT *
        ORDER BY
            github_workflow_job_id,
            tests_id,
            started_at,
            rerun_number
    )
)
ENGINE = SharedReplacingMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{uuid}/{shard}', '{replica}')
PARTITION BY toDate(started_at)
PRIMARY KEY (tests_id, environments_id, env_vars_id, started_at)
ORDER BY (tests_id, environments_id, env_vars_id, started_at, github_workflow_job_id, rerun_number)
TTL toDateTime(started_at) + toIntervalDay(14)
SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192, deduplicate_merge_projection_mode = 'rebuild'

lookup.sql:
WITH (
    SELECT groupArray((tests_id, environments_id, env_vars_id, started_at))
    FROM ci.runs
    PREWHERE id = {run_id: UUID}
) AS matched_keys
SELECT run.id AS id,
    toString(run.tests_id) AS tests_id_string,
    toString(run.environments_id) AS environments_id_string,
    toString(run.env_vars_id) AS env_vars_id_string,
    toString(run.github_workflow_job_id) AS github_workflow_job_id_string,
    run.report_uuid AS report_uuid,
    run.rerun_number AS rerun_number,
    run.outcome AS outcome,
    run.outcome_summary AS outcome_summary,
    run.started_at AS started_at,
    run.ended_at AS ended_at
FROM ci.runs AS run FINAL
PREWHERE (run.tests_id, run.environments_id, run.env_vars_id, run.started_at) IN (
    SELECT arrayJoin(matched_keys)
)
WHERE run.id = {run_id: UUID}
LIMIT 2
SETTINGS optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 0

runs_join.sql:
SELECT
    run.id AS id,
    toString(run.tests_id) AS tests_id_string,
    toString(run.environments_id) AS environments_id_string,
    toString(run.env_vars_id) AS env_vars_id_string,
    toString(run.github_workflow_job_id) AS github_workflow_job_id_string,
    run.report_uuid AS report_uuid,
    run.rerun_number AS rerun_number,
    run.outcome AS outcome,
    run.outcome_summary AS outcome_summary,
    run.started_at AS started_at,
    run.ended_at AS ended_at,
    toString(if(run_test.has_catalog = 1, run_test.file, NULL)) AS sort_0,
    toString(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(run.started_at)) AS sort_1,
    toString(run.environments_id) AS sort_2,
    toString(run.env_vars_id) AS sort_3,
    toString(run.github_workflow_job_id) AS sort_4,
    toString(run.rerun_number) AS sort_5
FROM (
    SELECT id, tests_id, environments_id, env_vars_id, github_workflow_job_id,
        report_uuid, rerun_number, outcome, outcome_summary, started_at, ended_at
    FROM ci.runs AS run FINAL
    WHERE run.tests_id = {test_id: UInt64}
) AS run
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT test.id AS id, test.file AS file, toUInt8(1) AS has_catalog
    FROM ci.tests AS test FINAL
    WHERE test.id = {test_id: UInt64}
) AS run_test ON run_test.id = run.tests_id
WHERE 1
    AND (1)
ORDER BY if(run_test.has_catalog = 1, run_test.file, NULL) ASC NULLS LAST, run.started_at DESC, run.environments_id ASC, run.env_vars_id ASC, run.github_workflow_job_id ASC, run.rerun_number ASC
LIMIT {entries_limit: UInt64}
SETTINGS optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 0

commit_default.sql:
WITH (
    SELECT groupArray(id)
    FROM default.workflow_job
    WHERE run_id IN (
        SELECT id
        FROM default.workflow_run
        WHERE id IN (
            SELECT id
            FROM materialized_views.workflow_run_by_head_sha
            WHERE head_sha = {sha: String}
        )

commit_union.sql:
WITH (
    SELECT groupArray(id)
    FROM default.workflow_job
    WHERE run_id IN (
        SELECT id
        FROM default.workflow_run
        WHERE id IN (
            SELECT id
            FROM materialized_views.workflow_run_by_head_sha
            WHERE head_sha = {sha: String}
        )
            AND head_sha = {sha: String}
            AND repository.full_name = {repo: String}
    )
) AS matched_job_ids,
(
    SELECT groupArray(test_start)
    FROM (
        SELECT (run.tests_id, run.started_at) AS test_start
        FROM ci.runs AS run
        WHERE run.github_workflow_job_id IN (SELECT arrayJoin(matched_job_ids))
        GROUP BY run.tests_id, run.started_at
        HAVING count() > 1
    )
) AS shared_starts
SELECT
    run.id AS id,
    toString(run.tests_id) AS tests_id_string,
    toString(run.environments_id) AS environments_id_string,
    toString(run.env_vars_id) AS env_vars_id_string,
    toString(run.github_workflow_job_id) AS github_workflow_job_id_string,
    run.report_uuid AS report_uuid,
    run.rerun_number AS rerun_number,
    run.outcome AS outcome,
    run.outcome_summary AS outcome_summary,
    run.started_at AS started_at,
    run.ended_at AS ended_at,
    toString(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(run.ended_at)) AS sort_0,
    toString(run.tests_id) AS sort_1,
    toString(run.environments_id) AS sort_2,
    toString(run.env_vars_id) AS sort_3,
    toString(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(run.started_at)) AS sort_4,
    toString(run.github_workflow_job_id) AS sort_5,
    toString(run.rerun_number) AS sort_6
FROM (
    SELECT id, tests_id, environments_id, env_vars_id, github_workflow_job_id,
        report_uuid, rerun_number, outcome, outcome_summary, started_at, ended_at
    FROM ci.runs AS run
    WHERE run.github_workflow_job_id IN (SELECT arrayJoin(matched_job_ids))
        AND (run.tests_id, run.started_at) NOT IN (SELECT arrayJoin(shared_starts))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id, tests_id, environments_id, env_vars_id, github_workflow_job_id,
        report_uuid, rerun_number, outcome, outcome_summary, started_at, ended_at
    FROM ci.runs AS run FINAL
    PREWHERE (run.tests_id, run.started_at) IN (SELECT arrayJoin(shared_starts))
    WHERE run.github_workflow_job_id IN (SELECT arrayJoin(matched_job_ids))
) AS run
WHERE 1
    AND (1)
ORDER BY run.ended_at DESC, run.tests_id ASC, run.environments_id ASC, run.env_vars_id ASC, run.started_at ASC, run.github_workflow_job_id ASC, run.rerun_number ASC
LIMIT {entries_limit: UInt64}
SETTINGS optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 0,
    enable_optimize_predicate_expression = 0
